intro: Yoga capital and white-water rafting on the Ganga. That is Rishikesh in one line — but there is a lot more to it. This guide covers when to go, where to stay and what not to miss.

sections.heading: Why visit Rishikesh
paragraphs: Rishikesh (Uttarakhand) is known for its spiritual, adventure and river experiences. Overall it is budget-friendly — hostels, homestays and local food keep costs low.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is September to November and February to May.

sections.heading: Top things to do
list: Evening Ganga aarti at Triveni Ghat or Parmarth Niketan
Walking across Laxman Jhula and Ram Jhula

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Fly to Dehradun (Jolly Grant), about 45 minutes away, or take a train or bus to Haridwar/Rishikesh.

sections.heading: Where to stay
list: Laxman Jhula area for river views

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Rafting is usually closed during the monsoon months — plan around it.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Rishikesh?
faq.a: September to November and February to May.
Fly to Dehradun (Jolly Grant), about 45 minutes away, or take a train or bus to Haridwar/Rishikesh.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Rishikesh?
faq.a: Popular choices: Tapovan for cafés and yoga; Laxman Jhula area for river views; Shivpuri for riverside camps.
